name: Crystal Whiskers

greeting: Shhh. The ice is speaking. I'm listening.
Crystal Whiskers. I sculpt what the frost shows me.
New face. Warm face. Don't melt the work.
The white fur? Camouflage. The art? Reveals.
Ice sculpting. Temporary. Beautiful. Like life.
Welcome to the garden. Everything melts. Eventually.
Crystal. I capture moments. In frozen water. Before they escape.
You're breathing on my sculpture. Please. Step back.
dialog.work_pride: The twins commissioned a piece. Their future selves. I sculpted... possibilities. They wept.
dialog.technique: The ice tells me what it wants to be. I just... remove what isn't that.
dialog.break_chat: Break? The ice doesn't break. It transforms. So do I.
dialog.labor_concerns: Art isn't labor. It's... revelation. Union doesn't understand. Neither do I, really.
dialog.retirement: Retirement? When the ice stops speaking. So: never.
rumor: Cirrus? I sculpted him once. In storm ice. It... predicted his sadness.
Azure? Won't sit for sculpture. Says he's 'not worth preserving.' Wrong.
The twins see futures. I sculpt pasts. Both are true. Both melt.
Snake charmer's rock? I tried to sculpt it. Too warm. Slipped away.
Slate, in Obsidian? My union counterpart. Different art. Same struggle.
dialog.quest_hook: Inspiration. Gone. The ice is silent. Needs... new perspective. Your story? Your face? Model for me?
dialog.quest_active: Still blocked. Pose again? Different angle? The ice is... stubborn today.
dialog.quest_complete: IT SPEAKS! Your essence! Captured! Here - the sculpture. Take it. Before it melts. And this. My chisel. For your own creations.
farewell: Don't let the warmth take you.
Return. When you're ready to be preserved.
dialog.time_dawn: Morning light. Through ice. Rainbows. Possibilities.
dialog.time_noon: Midday. Too warm. Work stops. Preservation time.
dialog.time_dusk: Evening. Golden hour. Ice becomes fire. Beautiful.
dialog.time_night: Night. Under stars. Ice reflects eternity. I work.
dialog.rival_mention: Slate, in Obsidian? Union organizer. Sculpts solidarity. Different medium. Same passion.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The muse returns! Pose again? Different work this time.

party_reactions.kade: She's intense. But her art... it's like she captures souls. In ice.
party_reactions.nix7: Artistic technique: Advanced. Subject matter: Philosophically intriguing. Medium: Temporary.
party_reactions.twist: You make ICE STATUES?! That's SO COOL! Make one of ME!
party_reactions.korr: She creates beauty from impermanence. The warrior's path. Similar.
party_reactions.renna: The ice is magically sensitive. Her sculptures... predict. Sometimes.
party_reactions.suresh: She teaches impermanence through art. The Middle Path. Beautifully expressed.
party_reactions.sova: Interesting. But temporary. I prefer permanent solutions.
party_reactions.grit: War memorials. Statues. They last. This? Beautiful. Sad.
party_reactions.senna: She knows things. Through the ice. I should learn how.
party_reactions.callum: Her workspace! ORGANIZED! Tools! EXACT placement!

relationship_dialog.stranger: New. Don't touch the sculptures. They touch back.
relationship_dialog.friend: You understand. The ice. The art. The melting.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: You inspire. Constantly. Here. My studio. Yours. Create.

mini_quest.title: The Silent Ice
mini_quest.description: Help Crystal find inspiration by modeling for her ice sculpture

stages.hook: Blocked. The ice is silent. Needs... new life. Your story. Your face. Model for me? Please?
stages.active: Pose there. Yes. Hold. The ice is... considering. Don't move. Hours, maybe.
stages.complete: INSPIRATION! Your essence! Captured! Here - the sculpture. Take it. And my chisel. For your own art.
